<style>
  /* Premium gradient hero background */
  .dnd-section:first-child,
  .dnd-section[class*="hero"],
  body .dnd-section:first-of-type {
    background: linear-gradient(
      145deg,
      #060e1a 0%,
      #0b1829 25%,
      #122a45 50%,
      #0e1f38 75%,
      #080f1e 100%
    ) !important;
    position: relative;
  }
  .dnd-section:first-child::before,
  .dnd-section:first-of-type::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: 15%;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    width: 70%;
    height: 60%;
    background: radial-gradient(ellipse, rgba(18, 42, 69, 0.6) 0%, transparent 70%);
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 0;
  }
  .dnd-section:first-child::after,
  .dnd-section:first-of-type::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 256 256' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='noise'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.9' numOctaves='4' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23noise)' opacity='0.03'/%3E%3C/svg%3E");
    background-repeat: repeat;
    background-size: 256px 256px;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 0;
  }
  .dnd-section:first-child .dnd-column,
  .dnd-section:first-of-type .dnd-column,
  .dnd-section:first-child .dnd-row,
  .dnd-section:first-of-type .dnd-row {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
  }
  .dnd-section {
    background-color: #0a1628 !important;
  }
  /* Bookend gradient on last CTA section */
  .dnd-section:last-of-type {
    background: linear-gradient(
      145deg,
      #080f1e 0%,
      #0e1f38 40%,
      #122a45 60%,
      #0b1829 100%
    ) !important;
    position: relative;
  }
</style>

<!-- BrandCommand: footer redesign -->
<style>
/* ── Footer Complete Redesign ── */
footer, .footer, .hs-footer, [data-hs-cos-type="footer"],
body > div:last-child > footer,
.body-container > footer {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #060e1a 0%, #0b1829 100%) !important;
  padding: 40px 5% 0 !important;
  margin-top: 0 !important;
  font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif !important;
}

/* Hide excessive footer widgets/sections - keep only essentials */
footer .hs-menu-wrapper,
.footer .hs-menu-wrapper,
footer .widget-type-menu,
.footer .widget-type-menu {
  display: block !important;
}

/* Footer inner container - CSS Grid 3 columns */
footer .content-wrapper,
footer .page-center,
footer > div:first-child,
.footer .content-wrapper,
.footer .page-center,
.footer > div:first-child,
footer .row-fluid,
.footer .row-fluid {
  display: grid !important;
  grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr !important;
  gap: 30px !important;
  max-width: 1200px !important;
  margin: 0 auto !important;
  padding: 0 20px !important;
  align-items: start !important;
}

/* All footer text styling */
footer, footer *,
.footer, .footer * {
  color: #8a8f9b !important;
  font-size: 14px !important;
  line-height: 1.6 !important;
  border: none !important;
}

/* Footer headings */
footer h1, footer h2, footer h3, footer h4, footer h5, footer h6,
.footer h1, .footer h2, .footer h3, .footer h4, .footer h5, .footer h6 {
  color: #ffffff !important;
  font-size: 15px !important;
  font-weight: 600 !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px !important;
  text-transform: uppercase !important;
  margin-bottom: 12px !important;
}

/* Footer links */
footer a, .footer a {
  color: #8a8f9b !important;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  transition: color 0.2s ease !important;
  display: block !important;
  padding: 2px 0 !important;
}
footer a:hover, .footer a:hover {
  color: #c4a44a !important;
}

/* Footer list items - compact */
footer ul, .footer ul {
  list-style: none !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
}
footer li, .footer li {
  padding: 2px 0 !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
}

/* Footer images (logos) - constrain */
footer img, .footer img {
  max-height: 40px !important;
  width: auto !important;
  margin-bottom: 12px !important;
  filter: brightness(0) invert(1) !important;
  opacity: 0.9 !important;
}

/* Social icons */
footer .social-links a,
footer .hs-social-media a,
.footer .social-links a,
.footer .hs-social-media a {
  display: inline-block !important;
  margin-right: 12px !important;
  opacity: 0.7 !important;
}
footer .social-links a:hover,
footer .hs-social-media a:hover,
.footer .social-links a:hover,
.footer .hs-social-media a:hover {
  opacity: 1 !important;
  color: #c4a44a !important;
}

/* Copyright bar */
footer .footer-bottom,
footer .copyright,
footer > div:last-child,
.footer .footer-bottom,
.footer .copyright {
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(138, 143, 155, 0.15) !important;
  margin-top: 30px !important;
  padding: 15px 0 !important;
  text-align: center !important;
  font-size: 12px !important;
  grid-column: 1 / -1 !important;
}

/* Remove any background images in footer */
footer [style*="background-image"],
.footer [style*="background-image"] {
  background-image: none !important;
}

/* Reduce overall footer height */
footer .span12, .footer .span12,
footer .cell, .footer .cell {
  padding: 0 !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
}

/* Hide duplicate/empty sections */
footer .dnd-section:empty,
.footer .dnd-section:empty {
  display: none !important;
}

/* DnD rows in footer - flatten */
footer .dnd-section,
.footer .dnd-section {
  padding: 0 !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  max-width: 100% !important;
}
footer .dnd-column,
.footer .dnd-column {
  padding: 0 10px !important;
}
</style>
htmlTitle: SalesBlitz as a Service | Rapid Pipeline Generation | Quantum Business Solutions

list.list_item: Stop spending $10,000s on more salespeople and make the most out of the investments you have already made!
Unlock a Predictable Pipeline and scale your company
Book meetings so you can close more deals faster!

params.content:
NEED TO HIT YOUR PIPELINE NUMBER, FAST?

Our SalesBlitz service is your on-demand outbound engine. We partner with your sales team to build laser-focused lists and irresistible scripts, then leverage the conversation-acceleration power of ConnectAndSell to book qualified meetings.
 
Stop burning valuable sales hours on manual dialing, navigating phone trees, and leaving voicemails. We provide the people, process, and technology to bypass the noise and get your team directly into meaningful conversations that build pipeline—immediately.

card_item.content:
Why I need it:

Frustrated executives are tired of missing out on millions of dollars in sales because they cannot create, control and convert enough leads.
It's a problem that plagues businesses around the world - how to get more customers? The answer might be as close as your fingertips with our SalesBlitz as a Service!

What it is:

We all know that the sales process can be a difficult and time-consuming task. But with our new SalesBlitz as Service program, you'll have an easy-to-understand, scalable, and repeatable pipeline without any of those pesky challenges associated with it.

Result:

Let's work together to increase your business success! We will help you close more deals by managing all of the meetings for you so that it is just a matter of making sure everything goes according to plan. You can focus on what matters most- running and growing your own company from home or anywhere else where there are no distractions.

People

We are committed to your success. We collaborate with and train your talented people to allow immediate pipeline growth!

Process

If you're looking to maximize your sales reps' productivity, then look no further. Our tools will streamline all of their information straight into the call queue so they can make more calls in less time!

Technology

For those looking for a more hands-on approach, our SalesBlitz as Service program offers the most advanced conversation technology in order to help you close deals.
